purpose: Keep independent current site data publishable when one identifiable presentation item is invalid, while preserving fail-closed global authority and integrity guarantees.

local_isolatable.rule: A defect is local only when the exact object/field identity is known and the remainder of the payload remains independently attributable to current canonical sources.
examples: one paid-card player-facing explanation fails presentation validation
one paid-card description claims a publishable state but its text is invalid
one paid-card optional grounded-negative presentation cannot be safely finalized
one giveaway game/offer has invalid presentation fields while the giveaway snapshot remains globally trusted

global_integrity.rule: A defect is global when canonical source identity, whole-payload schema/authority, material binding, or current production scope cannot be established safely.
examples: missing or unreadable canonical source required to compute current status
material/source drift that prevents proving which snapshot a full visual represents

local_fallback.preferred: reuse last-known-good presentation fragment only with exact same-item identity and compatibility proof
local_fallback.otherwise: omit only the invalid presentation field or hide only the invalid item

quarantine.duplicate_rule: same stable defect_id is updated in place; repeated observation must not append duplicates
quarantine.resolution_rule: a previously pending defect absent from the complete current local-defect observation is marked resolved

status_projection.source_rule: derive from current canonical GitHub production state, never by counting rendered cards in the browser
